LESSON: WEDDING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The  Learners to mention incidences of baptism they 1. In which place was life 
Topic 3.4: Wedding

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Wedding. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how Jesus changed ● Learners to tell the response of the servants to Jesus’ Cana of Galilee?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss how the servants obeyed Jesus’ instructions and relate it to their daily life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. discuss how the servants obeyed Jesus’ instructions and relate it to their daily life
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to discuss how the servants obeyed Jesus’ instructions and relate it to their daily life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Wedding.
2. Explain Wedding to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Wedding.
4. Show that you can: discuss how the servants obeyed Jesus’ instructions and relate it to their daily life
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Wedding. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how Jesus changed ● Learners to tell the response of the servants to Jesus’ Cana of Galilee?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. discuss how the servants obeyed Jesus’ instructions and relate it to their daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
